infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cheer Pressure uses the camera during your daily hello with Cheri. Worked out on this phone; nothing is recorded or sent.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cheer Pressure uses the microphone during your daily hello with Cheri. Worked out on this phone; nothing is recorded or sent.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Cheer Pressure reads your sleep and steps to notice changes compared with your own usual. They stay on this phone.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Only the development version of Cheer Pressure writes to Health: made-up sample weeks for testing, which it can remove again. The app you use never writes to Health.
